I've written the review report, and the verdict is **pass**. It has four small notes and no required fixes.

- **Requirements:** the census picked 12 modules at 5–6 importers each. Each module got one `doc/architecture.md`, one `doc/files.jsonl` entry and one readme "More" line.
- **Not verified:** I didn't check the per-module commits, the census after-count or the landing line. They aren't visible in the diff.
- **Layout:** the four shot pages (Search, Dropdown, editor, Menu) keep the same layout, with no horizontal overflow and the tab bar on one row at 400. I looked at the Search sheet and read the other three from their `layout.json`.
- **Words:** the architecture doc I sampled (tooltip) has no dates, "the owner said" lines or stubs.

The notes in the report cover two small wording corrections, one in the Dropdown readme and one in the `core/new` readme. They also flag the editor's comma-separated `notes:` line, which matches its own file's style.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/architecture-md-6/review/report.md`.
